title: Sales agent: semantic model for Dynamics 365 and Salesforce CRM data
summary: Hold: the briefing omits Microsoft's notice announcing general availability on 17 November 2026 and instead reports only the later roadmap target. It also leaves a documented Salesforce environment exception unresolved, overstates the absence of automation, and gives an unsupported storage-saving instruction.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap platforms are Desktop, Mobile, Teams and Surface Devices, and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Desktop", "Mobile", "Teams and Surface Devices", "Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap preview target is October CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "October CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap general availability target is December CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified on 11 November 2026.
Microsoft plans a semantic model that helps Sales agent interpret CRM business language and questions spanning related records.
claims.quote: Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.

claims.claim: The roadmap model covers tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values and glossary terms.
claims.quote: It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms.

claims.claim: The roadmap says Dynamics 365 admins enable the model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure its data coverage and signals.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use.

claims.claim: For Salesforce, the roadmap starts from existing table and glossary configuration and allows additional relationship and view signals in the maker portal.
claims.quote: For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal.

claims.claim: The briefing presents only the December roadmap target as the announced general availability timing.
claims.quote: This feature will reach general availability on November 17, 2026.
claims.fix: Retain December CY2026 explicitly as the roadmap target, but add that Microsoft's notice MC1540293 announces general availability on November 17, 2026, and says no action is required. Cite https://admin.microsoft.com/Adminportal/Home#/MessageCenter/:/messages/MC1540293 and report the discrepancy rather than silently choosing the roadmap.

claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ environment enable disable PowerShell API semantic model settings. Opened quickstart, default-settings, fine-tune-semantic-model-signals and ask/manage-semantic-models. No enable/disable API for the existing Sales agent model was documented.

Do not equate the Sales agent entity list with the Dataverse search index configuration.
